title: SURVEY OF CRIME ## Cases reported During the year under review (1966), a total number of 7,94,733 cases of cognizable offences (under the Indian Penal Code) were reported as against 7,51,615 during 1965, indicating an increase of 6·0% over the previous year. These figures include crimes committed by juveniles. Table I presents the comparative position of (i) incidence of total cognizable crime reported; (ii) estimated population; and (iii) volume of crime during the last six years, viz. 1961 to 1966.
